claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.bonus_action_as_standard_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit fits the existing species_trait activation family, but the surface cannot currently encode taking a specific standard action, here Dash, using the bonus-action quota. Existing variants can express either the quota or the action kind, but not both together.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

discrepancies: no content/species_orc_adrenaline_rush.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
